gaps.title: Epidemiological Data Cataloging, Search, and Management
gaps.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to catalog, search, and manage epidemiological data records, so that data can be effectively organized alongside protocols and materials.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given epidemiological data records, When a user attempts to catalog, search, or update them, Then the system provides dedicated backend models, REST endpoints, and UI views to perform these operations.
gaps.reason: literal brief requirement: The brief explicitly requests a web system for 'каталогизации, поиска и управления эпидемиологическими материалами, протоколами и данными' (cataloging, searching, and managing epidemiological materials, protocols, and data). While materials and protocols have dedicated models, services, endpoints, and UI components, epidemiological data management is completely absent.

gaps.title: Authentication and Session Management Interface
gaps.jtbd: When accessing administrative management capabilities, I want an authentication login and session mechanism, so that write operations (creating, updating, deleting materials and protocols) are restricted to authorized users.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given an unauthenticated web session, When a user attempts to perform management operations (create, edit, delete), Then the UI prompts for credentials and authenticates requests against the secured backend API endpoints.
gaps.reason: domain-standard expectation: A system for managing epidemiological knowledge requires user authentication and session management to secure write operations against unauthorized tampering. While Spring Security protects protocol API endpoints with ROLE_ADMIN, the frontend provides no login interface or credentials/session handling.
